notes.title: Dungeon & Cocks Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016202/aef3a6966045e524a8619326af1e489e0d43920f.png[/img]

[b]Dear players![/b]

[u]The Bratans[/u] team is pleased to present to you our brand new title, Dungeons and cocks. Coming at the end of 2020! Prepare for new chapter of Matthew Delaney journey!

[b]Dungeons & Cocks[/b] (Dungeons and Roosters, if you mind the official name) is a third-person adventure game that combines the features of good old three-dimensional platformers and ancient adventure games with shooting, puzzles, riddles and stealth mode (low-poly Lara  is the closest comparasant).
The plot of the game is dedicated to the life story of Matthew Delaney, an elderly Bon vivant who was forced to leave his country, after it had been captured and ravaged by the geese. Accomanied by his loyal friends: the goose merchant , the young pimp and a Conquistador the Bear, he reaches the shores of the New World, where he was going to sell the goods he had obtained with difficulty in previous wanderings. But the unknown land does not welcome old Delaney as warmly as he planned...
[b][h2]Features[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Plunge you into the atmosphere of old adventure games and 3-D platformers;
[*] Combine different game mechanics: Stealth, platform, puzzle, melee and shooting combat system;
[*] Enjoy deeply developed world and culture of the Cocks. The prototypes are taken from the cultures of the Mayas, Incas and other Central American natives.
[*] Explore about thirty well developed levels in 8 different zones;
[*] Dungeons & Cocks is a paradise for those who like to collect achievements and search for secrets.
[*] Luxirate latent, implicit, deeply encrypted neofreidism: coks, flying geese, cacti of unprecedented shapes and worship of black holes and red giants.

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016202/24878d563680d1939651ca6fe63fcf5b98c254cb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bogatyr strikes back!
notes.content:
Dear brothers and sisters! TheBratans team are glad to present you new update for our game!
What's new:
- New quest and new quest characters. Check out the Svyatovidsk are to find out what's new.
- New in-game objects.
- New dialogs.
What we fixed:
- From community requests we added heal during saving and loading. 30 health now added during loading for players.
- Ermolay and Forester dialog's English versions are fixed.

notes.title: Bogatyr: Cavern Depths FREE DLC
notes.content:
First DLC to Bogatyr the game.

theBratans team is proud to present the audience and fance our brand new big update of Bogatyrs adventures in the depths of the Well. Will you be able to find exit from deep dark caves under the Zhmenki village? 

WARNING: Do not go down the well in Zhmenki before you finish main quest. It's up to  players, but it is our game-developers duty to preinform YOU!

What is new in CAVERN DEPTHS DLC:
[list]
[*] New location with authentic lightning and dozen of new props.
[*] New Boss Fight and boss. With picant dialogs.
[*] 4 new enemy types
[*] New quests and dialogue lines
[*] Pastor Devis character that evolves and evaluates Bogatyr's world and lore.
[*] New tracks originally performed in Bogatyr beta (+ ears)
[/list]

Several issues were also fixed: 
- Level up is now slowered, you can also go higher than 5th level and increase your HP.
- Level up now fully heals player.
- Minor sound fixes

notes.title: Bogatyr Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016202/b847d3c26749e682fbc81a284bffb1c5d441fe67.jpg[/img]Fellow gamers,
It may sound like a surprise for you, but the bratans team is still making the Bogatyr game better and better, trying to fix most of the issues our community pointed at. Here you may see bugs fixed and features added recently:
- Map Legend has been updated (inteface is now not button-like)
- Cutscenes now skip automaticly.
- Game Objects (enemies, quest characters, animals) Navigation agents have been changed - now they cannot be moved by player.
- After Unequip action main strike ability UI now returns to default image.
- Sounds and Music Setting now work properly (sounds slider is active and volume level works better overall)
- Main Menu has been remastered
- New grass and flowers textures has been added
- Pig special attack has been fixed partially, sound of pig is less annoying now and pig has lifetime now;
- Characters like Egor & Oleg or Priest now starts game in new positions after their quests are completed (Only after LoadGame button)
- Quest Log visual has been updated (quest names and quest descriptions now differs from each other more)

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
We are glad to present one more hotfix for you. Here is what has changed in the Bogatyr the game:
1) Bogatyr Soundtrack is now available on Steam!!! Check it out.
2) Localization improvements - Mongol Scout, Farmer and Priest are now properly localized in English.
3) You now get experience when killing enemies with abilities.
4) Special Attack damages is now scaled to weapon type. Is reduced to Birch Wood peace and is higher for Poleaxe, mace and sword.
4) Most of achievements are now fixed.
5) Sand footsteps sound is now fixed .

notes.title: Bogatyr Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Good day to you, fellow players!
the Bratans team have carefully read your comments and we are making our best to make Bogatyr better.
Due to our main and only programmer being in Iraq at the release date it took some time for us to fix main issues and bugs. We yet have many to fox but we are happy to announce our first patch:

1) Dialogs. Many user complaint about localization. We have fixed all cases reported to us (please write us about every issue)

2) Optimization. We also dealt with problem with labs while walking and game crashes (problem was into fps max rate at 60). If any of fellow players still have that issue - please report. This fix may affect central processor load, but not critically.

3) FPS. We made additional efforts to make FPS in game higher and decrease number of lags cases.

4) Local forester, quest character, is now fixed.
